overview_description.description: OneStopKitchen ("OSK") offers advanced technology and innovative model which allows any restaurants to scale to multiple locations at zero cost. OSK offers entire suite of AI powered advanced restaurant inventory, ops and logistics tech to scale quickly with limited risk. OSK operationalize underperforming restaurant space and staff to run OSK kitchens which are located in prime downtowns and high walk-in areas. Think of AirBnB for restaurants. OSK is preferred restaurant partner due to its innovative hyper scalable model. Customers can mix & match multiple cuisines in a single order for dine in, pick up or delivery. Founders are highly technical, prior Google, Nvidia, Stanford engineers.
